title: CultureSynth: A Hierarchical Taxonomy-Guided and Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Cultural Question-Answer Synthesis
reasoning: The paper features a core evaluation component for religion and ethics. Specifically, its cultural taxonomy includes 'Religion and Theology' (RT) and 'Philosophy and Psychology' (PP, which covers Metaphysics and Ethics) as two of its 12 primary topics, with detailed evaluation of LLM performance across these specific domains.
